integrity: Nine-state rational generating equations, exact coefficient signs, ordered rational root certificates, Sturm count and reproducible NumPy spectral cross-checks included.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a two-site open pausing-TASEP with equal unit entry, hop and exit rates, independent exponential pausing and unpausing, and long-window stationary counts; does not cover other lengths, generic boundary rates or absolute publication priority.
title: A unique pausing-noise resonance and a sharp super-Poisson transition in a two-site exclusion process
